PullRequest.Title: sessions: introduce session list archiving from the merged-PR nudge
PullRequest.Body:
Follow-up to #335360, which has now merged.

## Summary
- On the first Archive / Mark as Done activation from the merged-PR nudge, open the Sessions list, reveal the target session, and keep its row action visible while a spotlight explains how to use it.
- Show one **Understood** button and defer archiving until the spotlight ends. **Escape also ends the spotlight and proceeds with archiving**, by design.
- Reuse onboarding's persisted shown state so subsequent nudge activations archive directly. Respect `onboarding.enabled` and revalidate the suggestion after the tour.
- Preserve list filters, release temporary action visibility, and abort without archiving if the target cannot be shown.
- Add Archive / Mark as Done visual fixtures, accessibility help, and regression coverage for deferred execution, retries, stale sessions, persistence, focus, and target visibility.

## Validation
- Core compilation/type-check: passed (0 errors)
- Layer validation: passed
- Scoped hygiene: passed
- Focused Sessions, archive-nudge, spotlight, and onboarding tests: **198 distinct tests passing after rebase**

- Visual verification: Archive in dark/high contrast and Mark as Done in light; only Understood is visible in the callout.

Scenarios.Scenario: Normal Sessions list refresh in workspace-grouped, capped mode
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Visible session/chat/model, active-session, host-filter, grouping, or filter changes synchronously call SessionsList.update, which filters, groups, sorts, partitions, caps, and rebuilds the tree before the UI reflects the change.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: All retained non-automation sessions grouped into workspace sections; the default five-session presentation cap is applied only after section construction and the added membership checks.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single-threaded synchronous UI work; active-session changes are coalesced to the next animation frame, while the other update sources invoke a direct rebuild.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The list keeps its sessions snapshot and tree, but update reconstructs section and child arrays. The presentation cap reduces rendered children, not the full arrays inspected by grouping and membership checks.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the onboarding observable defaults to undefined, while the added some calls still traverse uncapped section arrays on the synchronous update path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact retained-session counts and refresh rates vary by user. The diff's extra linear scans are certain, but their duration relative to the pre-existing collection-wide sort and tree rebuild is workload-dependent.
Scenarios.Verdict: The diff introduces repeated steady-state O(N) membership scans when no tour is active. Multiple report_finding submissions were attempted on both added anchors, but the reporting endpoint rejected them.

Scenarios.Scenario: First Archive or Mark as Done activation from the merged-PR nudge
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The click revalidates eligibility, joins the globally serialized onboarding scenario queue, opens and expands the Sessions view, synchronously reveals/rebuilds the target row, waits for one animation frame and user acknowledgment, then revalidates and performs the provider archive operation. When onboarding is disabled or already shown, it goes directly to the existing archive operation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Open/construct the Sessions view and reveal the target archive action
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One openView call and two synchronous list updates for the first eligible activation; zero after persisted shown state
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The nudge archived directly without opening the Sessions view.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before the spotlight can be shown; cold construction is on the first-activation critical path

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One shown write and one outcome write for the one-step run; retries add another pair only after an abort/reset
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No onboarding state was written for archive-nudge activation.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Shown state is persisted before presentation; outcome is recorded before runScenario resolves

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Delegate one archive request to the owning session provider; agent-host providers may persist/fan out over their connection
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one archive call per successful activation; no fan-out by session collection size
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same one provider archive call ran immediately after the initial eligibility check.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Runs after acknowledgment and must complete before the archive action resolves

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Archive a detached remote worktree when the selected provider requires it
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one worktree archive operation for the one target session
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same provider-specific work ran directly from the nudge archive action.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Provider-specific archive work remains on the archive completion path, now deferred until after onboarding

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One target session and one spotlight step. Cold view opening processes the user's full session history; warm view opening reuses the existing SessionsList. Concurrent activations coalesce onto one onboarding promise.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The service coalesces concurrent archive-onboarding requests. The onboarding engine serializes scenarios globally; the provider archive starts only after this scenario completes or is skipped.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Persisted onboarding shown state avoids all view/spotlight work after the first completed or skipped run. The Sessions view is reused when already open. Failed/aborted tours reset shown state and retry later.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: call order, coalescing, global queueing, view opening, reveal updates, and single provider delegation are explicit in the changed and transitive code.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Cold Sessions view construction cost scales with retained history and the scenario can wait behind another onboarding tour; exact latency depends on current UI state and user acknowledgment. It runs once because successful/skipped state is persisted.
Scenarios.Verdict: No boundary fan-out, concurrency burst, or cache-lifecycle regression: the intentional one-time onboarding adds a single cold UI path and preserves exactly one archive boundary call.

Scenarios.Scenario: Generic spotlight rendering with custom acknowledgment labels and abort-on-missing targets
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After optional target preparation, abort targets resolve with one immediate DOM query; visible targets wait for finite animations or a 600 ms cap plus one animation frame, then the existing overlay lays out and renders the custom button label.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One DOM target query per abort-mode resolution and one localized string assignment per shown step; no polling is performed for abort mode.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Spotlight scenarios remain globally serialized by the onboarding engine; layout events are coalesced through the existing scheduled animation-frame layout.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Overlay DOM and buttons are reused within a presentation run; step listeners and rendered markdown are cleared between steps and disposed at run completion.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the new abort branch returns after the first findOnboardingTarget call, and custom label forwarding changes only existing overlay content.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: DOM query cost depends on document size, but abort mode removes the previous default two-second polling behavior rather than adding work.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression; abort-on-missing reduces waiting/polling, while label forwarding does not change layout frequency or retained resources.

Scenarios.CriticalPath: When accessibility help is requested, the provider reads configuration and appends one localized sentence before returning the generated text.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant one additional localized string when the archive nudge setting is enabled.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous single request; no queue or parallel work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No changed cache or retained state; content is generated on demand as before.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material; the added work is constant and only occurs when help content is requested.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass across all 17 changed files. Traced steady-state list rebuilds, first-run onboarding, spotlight layout/lifecycle, persistence, and provider archive boundaries. No fan-out, concurrency burst, unbounded retention, or startup regression was established. A steady-state repeated-scan issue was identified, but report_finding failed repeatedly on valid added-line anchors.
